items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember when Wallace -- while Stepen Fetchit was teaching a lady how to dance

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, Stepen Fetchit he was a mind, man, a brilliant mind. Because I can see---- Do you remember when Wallace -- while Stepen Fetchit was teaching a lady how to dance or something, and Wallace was here, and all of a sudden, Wallace kind of got away from the woman.
